note: Signature: placed web traps. Only hero with trap, venom, pull, sleep and backstep. Web and cocoon art: gondor_web/gondor_cocoon (spider_web, spider_cocoon). Cast pose: thread descent (ExtraPose00).

passives.name: Chitin
passives.text: +2 melee and +2 missile armor per level.

passives.name: Eight Eyes
passives.text: +1 Accuracy and +2% critical chance per level.

passives.name: Patient Hunter
passives.text: +5 max Spirit and +1 Spirit regeneration per level.

passives.name: Venom Sacs
passives.text: +2 poison damage and +8% poison resistance per level.

passives.name: Feast
passives.text: +2 health per kill and +3 max health per level.

passives.name: Old Hunger
passives.text: Below a quarter health she bites 3 harder per level.

passives.name: Lair Born
passives.text: +8% fear resistance and +1 health regeneration per level.

skills.name: Web Trap
skills.text: She spins a web at her feet. The first foes to walk in are stuck 3s, slowed and take {amount}.

skills.name: Venom Bite
skills.text: For {seconds}s her bites stack venom, {amount} a second each. At 5 stacks the foe is paralyzed.

skills.name: Reel In
skills.text: She spits a web line at the nearest foe and drags it right up to her: {amount} damage.

skills.name: Cocoon
skills.text: She wraps the nearest foe in silk: it is out of the fight for {seconds}s, until you strike it in melee.

skills.name: Skitter
skills.text: She scuttles back out of reach and leaves a web where she stood: it holds foes 2.5s and deals {amount}.

skills.name: Shelob's Lair
skills.text: She spins her lair: a ring of six webs that hold foes 3s, poison them and deal {amount}.
